systems.system: Réseau Intranet Administratif haut Débit en fibre optique (RIAD)

note: Draft e-participation policy; names the government intranet RIAD and a planned national cloud for public structures but puts no commune office on either. Its mentions of collectivités territoriales concern Morocco.
